name: timing-lanes
title: Timing lanes
description: Two horizontal lanes by date showing the lag between matching events.
needs: Date values on each side, such as capture date and settlement date.

text.title: {left} against {right}
text.lede: The top lane is the date of {leftShort}. The bottom lane is the date of {rightShort}. A line joins the two, so its slope is the wait. Steep lines settled on time; long, flat lines were late; a dot with no line never found its partner.
text.chartSub: Select a day to list its {unit}.
text.emptyDay: Nothing was recorded on this day.

options.name: dateField
options.description: Date field to plot on the lanes. Defaults to the first date field.
